content_of_post_to_comment: I'm tired of book recommendation lists that are all the same 10 books. Give me something everyone else isn't reading, recommend to me the books you loved that aren't currently making the rounds.
comment: There's a difference between an overlooked book and an overlooked reading experience. Sometimes the best recommendations aren't obscure titles, but books that found you at the wrong time before and might mean something entirely different now.
